だけど、手書きの入力方法と英語のキーボードをOFFにできれば、もっとすごくなると思う。

This is a great keyboard for Japanese, especially so if you can read all the instructions (of which are in kanji) but regardless, it's leagues better than the default keyboard for Japanese. Only things I can think of that would improve the experience: to be able to turn off/disable the English keyboard (I feel like it gets in the way when I want to switch to my other keyboard which is better for English), and the ability to hand draw in kanji would be be awesome!
